subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the exact current head be authorized to remove the temporary `qa-matrix` workspace manifest and lockfile importer after the predecessor stack is ready to land?
rationale: Repository automation deliberately requires an administrator or security owner to approve dependency-graph changes, even when the change only removes an internal workspace package.

options.title: Authorize after predecessor approval
options.body: Confirm the package ownership transfer is intentional, approve this exact SHA, and land it after the preceding stack.

options.title: Hold the cleanup
options.body: Leave authorization closed if the predecessor does not yet establish acceptable QA Lab ownership and dependency transfer.

recommendation.title: Authorize after predecessor approval
recommendation.body: Confirm the package ownership transfer is intentional, approve this exact SHA, and land it after the preceding stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The build and packaging history makes this the best available individual routing candidate, although the approval must still come from an eligible administrator or security owner.
